attacks.name: Claw Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Hamstring
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| and |§bleed§Bleed| special conditions.
|!wild| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may advance |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Too Dangerous to Ignore
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character targets another allied character with an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of range and LOS.

superPowers.name: Anklebiter
superPowers.body: This character cannot Contest or Interact with Secure objective tokens. Additionally, when an enemy character within |!range| 1 of this character is attacked by another allied character, that enemy character rolls 1 less defense die.

superPowers.name: Lil‘ Sis
superPowers.body: If an allied |*Laura Kinney| within |!range| 3 of this character is damaged by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character may advance |!range_medium| toward the character that damaged |*Laura Kinney|. This character may move only once per turn as a result of this superpower.
